v.company: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited
v.text: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the despatch of Notice of Postal Ballot
v.summary: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited has issued a notice for a postal ballot seeking shareholder approval for a special resolution. The resolution proposes raising funds up to Rs. 5,000 crores through a Qualified Institutions Placement of equity shares and convertible securities. The remote e-voting period commenced on 10 November, 2026, and ends on 9 December, 2026. Mr. R Sridharan has been appointed as the scrutinizer for the process. The voting results will be declared within two working days after the conclusion of e-voting, by 11 December, 2026. The resolution requires votes in favor to be not less than three times the votes against it.
